Protection noteLink

ProtectionRequired behavior
Master integrityDo not use these masters as live transaction files.
Working-copy controlDuplicate the right master first and rename the working copy immediately.
Evidence placementMove live working files into CRM, operations, or compliance as appropriate.
External languageKeep external language discipline inside 11_external-communications/.
Closeout and retirementKeep archive and retirement templates inside 08_closeout/ and 99_archive/.
Source-layer boundaryPreserve this hub as the protected drafting source layer; live transaction evidence belongs in the accountable operating room, not in the master template library.
